lines: Power of the one who obtained: the eldest, exactly thus rite should perform; if or the teacher properly not blazing of him before that.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śaktiṃ prāptavato jyeṣṭhāmevameva vidhiṃ caret yadi vā daiśikaḥ samyaṅ na dīptastasya tatpurā
